_source.title: 打开文档
_source.params.documentUuid: 文档 UUID，此处支持 {@link IDMT_SchematicItem.uuid}、{@link IDMT_SchematicPageItem.uuid}、{@link IDMT_PcbItem.uuid}、{@link IDMT_PanelItem.uuid} 作为输入
_source.params.splitScreenId: 分屏 ID，即 {@link DMT_EditorControl.getSplitScreenTree} 方法获取到的 {@link IDMT_EditorSplitScreenItem.id}
_source.returns: 标签页 ID，如若为 `undefined`，则打开文档失败

title: Open document
params.documentUuid: Document UUID. Here {@link IDMT_SchematicItem.uuid}, {@link IDMT_SchematicPageItem.uuid}, {@link IDMT_PcbItem.uuid}, and {@link IDMT_PanelItem.uuid} are supported as input
params.splitScreenId: Split screen ID, which is the {@link IDMT_EditorSplitScreenItem.id} obtained by the {@link DMT_EditorControl.getSplitScreenTree} method
returns: Tab ID, if it is `undefined`, then open document failed
